comments.body:
## RCA (rebar-debug Phase 1 exit) — confirmed root cause

**Mechanism (runtime-confirmed):** `_voter_error` (src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py:132-148) emits the line-start marker `VOTER_ERROR {json}` on TWO paths: `logger.error(line)` and `print(line, file=sys.stderr)`. `configure_logging()` (src/rebar/review_bot/config.py:129-168, called at import by `rebar.review_bot.app`) attaches a StreamHandler(sys.stdout) with `%(message)s` format to the `rebar` logger, so the logged copy ALSO lands at line start. journald ingests the container's stdout and stderr into ONE stream (`journalctl CONTAINER_NAME=… -o cat`), so the probe's anchored count (infra/scripts/observability.sh:166, `grep -cE '^VOTER_ERROR \{'`) counts each real error twice — matching the journal evidence (duplicate lines with identical microsecond timestamps: one record, two sinks).

**Runtime experiment (subprocess driving `_voter_error`, counting `^VOTER_ERROR \{` matches over stdout+stderr = the journald view):**
- configured logging: stdout=1 stderr=1 → probe_countable=2 (the bug)
- unconfigured logging: stdout=0 stderr=1 → probe_countable=1 (the fallback works; `lastResort` never fires because `src/rebar/__init__.py:159` installs a NullHandler on the `rebar` logger)

**Rival ruled out:** "the dual print was double-counting since day one" — false: before `configure_logging` existed, `logger.error` found only the NullHandler (found>0 → no lastResort), emitted nothing, and the count was correct (observability.sh's own calibration note: "221 line-start == 221 real", recorded pre-c130 era anchor fix 8c2f).

**caused_by (date test):** the implicated emitter lines shipped with the marker itself (1d1a072a75c, 2026-06-29, S4b/918c) and predate the transition — they did not cause it. The behavior became wrong when commit b0ac2544720 (2026-07-16, `rebar-ticket: c130-6a87-531e-4441`, irongray-profound-abalone, "configure logging so structured _emit INFO events reach stdout/journald") wired the rebar-logger handler, activating the logged copy of a marker that already had an unconditional stderr print. A reviewer of that change could plausibly have caught the double emission of the ERROR-level alarm markers. Class: **regression**. (The S4b commit is the carrier of the fix site, not the origin — divergence from whole-file blame noted deliberately.)

**Legitimacy (authoritative contract):** observability.sh:159-165 documents the anchored count as "matches every genuine record" and "a token is an alarm contract"; one real error must produce one countable line. Two violates it. Confirmed a defect, not working-as-designed.

**Sibling sweep (Step 7 Axis 1, construct = "line-start marker string passed to BOTH a logger call and a stderr print"):**
- CONFIRMED `MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR` — voter_merge.py `merge_change_error` (logger.error + print), anchored-counted at observability.sh:196 → live doubling of review_bot_merge_change_errors.
- CONFIRMED `RECONCILE_DEGRADED` — reconcile.py `_degraded` (logger.warning + print; docstring: "Mirrors voter's VOTER_ERROR marker convention") → doubled line-start marker in journald (no anchored counter today; latent for any future probe).
- CONFIRMED `ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR` — artifact_emit.py `_artifact_emit_error` (logger.warning + print) → same latent doubling.
- CLEAN `AUTODEPLOY_*` — autodeploy.sh `marker()` prints once to stderr; no logger path; not affected.

**Fix shape (per the ticket's preferred candidate — emitter-side single line-start emission):** keep the unconditional `print(line, file=sys.stderr)` as the ONE line-start marker emission (it is the fail-safe and works in both configured and misconfigured logging), and change the logger copy to log the structured record body (`json.dumps(record)`) WITHOUT the token prefix — same shape `_emit` already logs — so the log-stream copy stays for operators/caplog but can never match `^TOKEN \{`. Applied to all four confirmed sites. Structural class guard test prevents new markers reintroducing the construct.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Every VOTER_ERROR incident is counted twice by the host observability probe, doubling rebar/host:voter_errors. Journald evidence (Gerrit host, 2026-08-22): all five VOTER_ERROR records over Aug 20-22 appear twice with IDENTICAL microsecond timestamps; CloudWatch hourly sums show 2-3 per single-incident hour where journald shows one real error. The metric is useless for rate analysis and will mis-calibrate the companion alarm-recalibration task (ea5d-4932-8554-4544 depends on this fix).

Root cause (confirmed per rebar-debug; full RCA in the ticket comment): `_voter_error` (src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py) emits the line-start marker `VOTER_ERROR {json}` on TWO paths — `logger.error(line)` and `print(line, file=sys.stderr)`. `configure_logging()` (config.py, wired at import since commit b0ac2544720 / ticket c130-6a87-531e-4441) attaches a stdout StreamHandler with `%(message)s` format, so the logged copy also lands at line start; journald merges the container's stdout and stderr, so the probe's anchored count (infra/scripts/observability.sh:166, `grep -cE '^VOTER_ERROR \{'`) counts each real error twice. Runtime proof: configured logging → 2 anchor-matching lines per error; unconfigured → 1 (the print; `lastResort` never fires because src/rebar/__init__.py installs a NullHandler on the `rebar` logger).

Sibling sweep confirmed the same construct (line-start marker string passed to BOTH a logger call and a stderr print) at four more sites: one live-doubling today (MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR is anchored-counted at observability.sh:196), three latent (RECONCILE_DEGRADED, ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR, and LLM_TOKEN_USAGE in voter.py `_emit_token_usage` — logger.info + print, flagged by plan review; no anchored consumer today, doubling is latent for any future host-probe parse). AUTODEPLOY_* markers (autodeploy.sh `marker()`) print once to stderr with no logger path — clean. Downstream-consumer sweep for the logged token-prefixed copy: a repo-wide grep over infra/**, *.tf, *.sh, *.py, *.md finds the tokens consumed ONLY by observability.sh's anchored journald greps (plus prose mentions in .tf/.sh comments); no dashboard, log-shipping filter, or alternate anchor matches the logger-stream copy. The canonical stderr marker line is unchanged by this fix, and the logger copy retains the token as the JSON `event` value, so ad-hoc journal greps for the bare token still hit it.

## Approach

Emitter-side single emission, per the ticket's preferred candidate shape: keep the unconditional `print(line, file=sys.stderr)` as the ONLY line-start marker emission — it is the documented fail-safe and produces exactly one countable line whether logging is configured or not — and change the logger copy at each site to log the structured record body `json.dumps(record, default=str)` WITHOUT the token prefix (the same shape voter's `_emit` already logs for non-marker events). The log-stream copy remains visible to operators and caplog but can never match the probe anchor `^TOKEN \{`. No probe change needed: observability.sh's documented emitter contract ("voter.py prints \"VOTER_ERROR \" + json.dumps(record) to stderr") stays true; add a one-line note at the anchor comment that the logger copy deliberately does not match. A structural class-guard test prevents a future marker from reintroducing the dual line-start construct.

Default assumed: RECONCILE_DEGRADED and ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR are fixed in scope (same class, same one-line fix) rather than ticketed out — they cite/mirror voter's convention and the fix is identical.

## Scope

- src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py — `_voter_error`: logger.error logs the record body, not the token-prefixed line; comment updated to state the single-line-start-emission contract. Same change in `_emit_token_usage` (logger.info copy of LLM_TOKEN_USAGE).
- src/rebar/review_bot/voter_merge.py — `merge_change_error`: same change (live-doubling sibling, anchored at observability.sh:196).
- src/rebar/review_bot/reconcile.py — `_degraded`: same change (latent sibling).
- src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py — `_artifact_emit_error`: same change (latent sibling).
- infra/scripts/observability.sh — comment-only: note at the VOTER_ERROR/MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR anchor blocks that the emitters' logger copy intentionally does not match the anchor (keeps probe and emitter documented in lockstep).
- tests/unit/test_marker_single_emission_f829.py — new RED-first oracle: subprocess-driven, per emitter × {configured, unconfigured} logging, asserting exactly ONE `^TOKEN \{` line across stdout+stderr (the journald view); plus the structural class guard scanning src/rebar for the dual-emission construct.

## Testing

- RED before fix: the new test fails on the configured-logging cases (2 anchored lines) for all four emitters; unconfigured cases pass (fallback already single).
- GREEN after fix: all cases emit exactly one anchored line; unconfigured fallback still one (the print).
- Regression guard: existing suites (tests/unit/test_review_bot.py incl. the capsys VOTER_ERROR assertion, tests/scripts/test_observability_*.py) still pass — `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_review_bot.py tests/unit/test_marker_single_emission_f829.py tests/scripts -q` plus `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`.
- Structural guard: the class-guard test fails if any src/rebar file passes a `"<TOKEN> " + json.dumps(...)` string to a logger call (the exact construct that doubled).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Root cause confirmed per rebar-debug (runtime proof: drive _voter_error with configured logging and count journald-shaped lines on stderr+stdout) — RCA comment on this ticket cites the experiment and its counts.
- [x] One real error produces exactly one probe-countable marker line, while the misconfigured-logging fallback still produces one — verified by the new subprocess test in both logging modes for VOTER_ERROR.
- [x] Sibling voter_merge.py `merge_change_error` (MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR) single-emits, verified by the same parametrized test.
- [x] Sibling reconcile.py `_degraded` (RECONCILE_DEGRADED) single-emits, verified by the same parametrized test.
- [x] Sibling artifact_emit.py `_artifact_emit_error` (ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR) single-emits, verified by the same parametrized test.
- [x] Sibling voter.py `_emit_token_usage` (LLM_TOKEN_USAGE) single-emits, verified by the same parametrized test.
- [x] Structural class guard: a test scanning src/rebar fails if the dual line-start construct (token-prefixed marker string passed to a logger call) reappears — seen RED against the pre-fix tree, GREEN after.
- [x] AUTODEPLOY_* audit recorded (clean: single printf-to-stderr path, no logger) — in the RCA comment.
- [x] [non-codebase] caused_by attributed via the date test (c130-6a87-531e-4441 — the logging-config change activated the second path; the marker's dual emitter predates the transition) and passed as `--caused-by` on the close with `--class=regression`.
  provenance: environment=rebar tickets tracker (production store); principal=joeoakhart@navapbc.com session agent; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the caused_by edge is created BY the close command itself (rebar transition ... --class=regression --caused-by=c130-6a87-531e-4441), so it cannot exist in any pre-close snapshot; the attribution evidence (date test) is in the RCA comment on this ticket.
